summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026 to announce the planned appointment of Jann Brown to its Board of Directors effective October 1, 2026, and the promotion of Annette Malm Justad as Senior Independent Director. The announcement follows a planned succession process and includes commentary from Chair Simon Mackenzie Smith. No financial terms, transaction structure, or shareholder action is involved. This is a routine corporate governance update that does not constitute a special situation event. The filing maps to a standard non-special 6-K under SEC rules, disclosing board personnel changes. No deal terms, advisors, or tender/merger mechanics are present. What to watch: this is purely informational; no further analysis or risk-arb angle is warranted.
